_note: PLACEHOLDER numbers. THE DESIGN RULE (resources-skills-spec.md §2): every skill answers a specific kind of creature. If it is good against everything it is just a bigger attack. 'answers' names the problem it solves and is printed in the skill list, so the rule is visible to the player rather than only to us. Limiter is a round-counted COOLDOWN per skill and nothing else — no mana pool, deliberately: a second resource to track in every fight is the wrong overhead for this game, so stronger skills carry longer cooldowns instead. 'owner' ties a skill to a party member; when the party expands past two this moves onto the character. Fall Back from the spec is NOT here — it swaps ranks, and ranks aren't built (Q34).

skills.name: Unbind
skills.blurb: Pull at the seam holding a thing together.
skills.answers: Anything. The one that always works.

skills.name: Pry
skills.blurb: Find the gap and lever it open.
skills.answers: Heavily plated things, whose armour eats an honest swing.

skills.name: Overbear
skills.blurb: Everything you have, and you're out of position after.
skills.answers: Armoured and slow. You'll act last next round.

skills.name: Sight
skills.answers: Anything you haven't met. Tells you what it's wearing.

skills.name: Draw Off
skills.answers: Protecting Quill from something that would finish them.

skills.name: Quicken
skills.answers: Finishing something before it finishes you.

skills.name: Rout
skills.blurb: Leave, and the world doesn't notice you going.
skills.answers: The fight you should never have started. Costs no stability.

skills.name: Flense
skills.blurb: Open it, and keep it open.
skills.answers: Shaggy, thick-pelted things. Useless on plate.

skills.name: Ward
skills.blurb: Set yourself against one kind of harm.
skills.answers: Whatever you just learned is coming. Ask Sight first.

skills.name: Snuff
skills.blurb: Put out whatever it's giving off.
skills.answers: Things that burn, glow or reek — the damage armour can't stop.

skills.name: Steady
skills.answers: A wound that won't close on its own.

skills.name: Read
skills.blurb: Take it in properly. You'll know it again.
skills.answers: Collecting. A bestiary entry without a kill.
